answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 179747 Country: India Title: Income Tax return Question: Zaid works in a company. Company deducts Tax every month. Zaid is given option to file return of the taxes deducted mostly in July end to October. Zaid gives this activity to person who files return for Zaid and takes some amount as fees. Zaid does not know what this person does exactly to show return. Sometime more, sometime less rupees Zaid received in return from tax when this return activity is completed. Can Zaid use this amount, he got from return for day to day activities and spending? Answer ID: 179747 Posted on: Sep 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 61/38/H=1/1442) Zaid received the money of income tax which was deducted from his salary; hence he is its sole owner. It is lawful for Zaid to use this money for his daily needs. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
